parts.title: Morgan Recruitment Agency
parts.transcript: S1: Peter Smith phones Morgan Recruitment Agency for new staff. Contact number 047883925 (1). Company: Vander Transport (2, spelled V-A-N-D-E-R; large trucking company). Refrigerated trucks carrying frozen (3) goods. Staff to start from 28 August (4; 27th is a Sunday). Jobs: Office Manager liaises with a supermarket client, must have a degree (5). Mechanic repairs trucks and writes a report for every vehicle (6); little travel. Truck Driver covers long distances, will transport animals (7, new contract/trucks), and all drivers must clean (8) their truck between trips. Warehouse Supervisor: warehouse near the airport (9), and needs their own car (10, for nighttime on-call work).

parts.transcript: S3: Alice and Tim discuss their economics course and mentor Mr Jarvis. Q21-23 (THREE kinds of help BOTH get from the mentor) = building up confidence (A; both improved with Jarvis), preparation for exams (B; he coached both), and course selection (D; Alice discussed which course to choose next semester, Tim was advised to continue studying in this field). Not C/E (only wishes), not F (Tim 'not regarding my career'), not G (Tim hasn't asked yet). Q24 essays: 'thought it would be more difficult than it actually is' = easier than expected (A; both agree). Q25 Alice finds economics hard because she's had no previous experience = first time learning it (A; her maths is strong). Q26-30 (A only Alice / B only Tim / C both): put theory into practice = Only Alice (A; Tim says no practical use, Alice cites the practical project); networking = Both (C); experience of large organizations = Only Tim (B; Alice 'now I'm not so sure'); communication skills = Only Tim (B; Alice says not enough emphasis); identify a career plan = Both (C; Miss Hathaway's classes, both agree).
parts.instruction: You will hear two students, Alice and Tim, talking about the lectures they have had recently.

parts.title: Introduction to Taxation
parts.transcript: S4: Mr Dawkins from the Central Government Tax Agency on filing taxes. To certify income you need enough evidence (31), including wage statements, freelancer statements, invoices and bank (32) statements. The tax year runs from April (33) to end of March. You must ask your employers (34) for the employment statement (the agency can't help with that). Penalty for not filing: up to 3000 (35; audio $3,000). Tips: work out the latest tax rate when buying a (new) car (36); calculation (37) is easier with one single kind of tax. Online tax service: info takes little storage (38) space (can save & resume); fewer mistakes (39) are made (safeguards); complete a questionnaire (40) to find the right kind of form.
